evidence.quote: By default, however, traffic within the VPC is unencrypted. Node-to-node encryption enables TLS 1.2 encryption for all communications within the VPC.
Each OpenSearch Service domain—regardless of whether the domain uses VPC access—resides within its own, dedicated VPC.

claim: Each OpenSearch Service domain resides within its own, dedicated VPC; by default, traffic within that VPC is unencrypted, and node-to-node encryption enables TLS 1.2 encryption for all communications within the VPC.
